subject: how agents use truecap
preheader: send a sourced, co-branded analysis without promising the outcome.
headline: Give investor clients a decision they can review—not a vague cap-rate claim.
body: When an investor client asks whether a property pencils, a useful response shows the assumptions, cap rate, cash-on-cash, DSCR, cash flow, risks, and what would need to change—not just a headline yield.

A co-branded share link or report can make that review consistent and give the client a clear place to question rent, financing, expenses, and the offer ceiling. It does not guarantee a listing, offer, closing, or client outcome.

TrueCap's paid plans include branded reporting and client-facing workflows as listed on the pricing page. Review and replace benchmark starting data before sharing, and keep the estimate and due-diligence limitations visible.
Use the current pricing and feature matrix to decide whether the workflow fits your practice.
